title: ONS Registry
description: Open OXEN Name System list, updated automatically from the blockchain. Easily lookup ONS names and get all authors usernames.

search.search_by_owner_type: Paste OXEN wallet address or keypair

name_hashed.label: Hashed name
name_hashed.hint: We couldn't un-hash this name. It is probably something very unique. If you know what it is, type it to search and it will automatically be saved for other users.

value_encrypted.hint_hashed_name: We couldn't un-hash this name, thus it's impossible to know whom it belongs to. If you know what it is, type it to search and it will automatically be saved for other users.
value_encrypted.hint_legacy_argon2: We couldn't decrypt this field because it uses a legacy argon2id algorithm without salt. We are working on adding decryption for such fields.
